mentions.description: A command-line tool written in Go that interfaces with the author's Gramps Web service, built for genealogy research and personal data ownership.
mentions.problem: LLMs are great at genealogy work but there is a missing space for CLI interaction with Gramps; the author got into genealogy and wants to own their own data rather than depend on ancestry-style services. The code was rapidly prototyped ('vibed') but cleaning it up to a standard worthy of public release has proven a chore.
mentions.audience: Genealogists who use Gramps and want to own their own data rather than rely on hosted services.
mentions.author: loufe
